planned_contents.planned_content: A launch designed for attention with little customer benefit is flagged as validation-seeking rather than service.
A stated intention that is genuinely good paired with an execution plan that harms the people it is meant to serve is flagged, with the harm made concrete.
Meaningful low-visibility work being deprioritized only because it will not be seen is flagged as external validation displacing meaningful progress.
